name: After recital W
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law, fundamental rights and misuse of EU funds in Slovakia: the need for an EU response
part_text: Za. whereas upon its accession to the EU in 2004, the Slovak Republic acknowledged that the Beneš Decrees were to be regarded as historical legal acts without continuing legal effect; whereas serious concerns remain over the continued application of the Beneš Decrees in Slovakia, including cases of land confiscation affecting members of the Hungarian community and other minorities;
